3_description:
New from-scratch family `models_r2/r2s1_selected_form`
(worktree `worktrees/r2s1_direct/B2`), condition-only forward signature,
stripped view only, leakage tripwire, no LF at any stage.
Per dataset: train split → fit 80% / model-selection 10% / calibration 10%,
disjoint and asserted disjoint (LOO + fixed-epoch when `N_train < 20`, i.e.
ifc_poisson); no test quantity is consulted in any fit or selection step.
**Stage S (training-free, fit+selection folds only, written out before any
test scoring)**: centering form by `ratio = ||mean_i y_i|| / geomean_i
||y_i||` with pre-registered `tau = 1.0` (`>= tau` → `fact` = unit-L2
direction × `exp(mean log||y||)`; else `add` = plain mean-centred);
rank `r_sel = clip(#{POD modes with 5-fold OOF R^2 > 0.1 from the condition},
1, 32)` on a 50-mode fit-fold basis. **Head**: ridge from
`[1, standardized condition]` to the `r_sel` POD coefficients (`(d+1)*r_sel`
params — 60 on cahn_hilliard, 12 on pfc), alpha by exact LOO on a 13-point
log grid. **Wiener band gains**: 6 radial Fourier bands, coordinate descent
over a 41-point grid on [0, 2] (widened from B1's [0, 1.5] because B1's
cahn_hilliard optimum sat ON the 1.5 edge), 2 passes, fitted on the
*calibration* fold, applied identically to EVERY arm. **Blend**:
`lambda*arm + (1-lambda)*base`, 21-point grid, bases {zero, train_mean,
nn_condition, **dc_only**}, both chosen on the calibration fold.
**Arms**: scored `test_hf` = selected form; reference splits (never starting
with `test`) `ref_selrule_alt` (non-selected centering at `r_sel`),
`ref_rank_{1,2,3,5,8,12,20,32}`, `ref_head_rff16` (~10^3 params),
`ref_decoder_small` (w32/b2/modes16, ~10^5.6), `ref_decoder_big`
(w64/b4/modes16/latent16, B1 scale ~10^7.2; both early-stopped on the
model-selection fold), the uncalibrated twins `ref_raw_head` /
`ref_raw_decoder_big`, and the floors `ref_dc_only`, `ref_zero`,
`ref_train_mean`, `ref_nn_condition` (the three frozen ones seam-checked to
`state/anchors/floors.json` at 1e-9, RAISING on mismatch).
**Diagnostics (JSON, non-scored)**: selection statistics + chosen form; the
full rank × centering test curve with the oracle-rank entry explicitly
labelled ORACLE; the calibrated↔uncalibrated delta per arm; the R = 5
fold-resample paired spread of (`test_hf` − `ref_decoder_big`) per dataset;
per-class pfc scoring from a condition-only classifier fitted on train.
Guards `heat_local, fluid, sharp__sod_1d` at contract tier (2 epochs).
The decoder arms are **declared in-round baseline arms** (batch-1 verdict:
bare conditioned decoders are `preempted`), not the contribution.

H-r2s1-B2 — "the condition→HF map
on this panel is identification-limited, not capacity-limited, and a
pre-registered training-free selection of output parameterization plus
out-of-fold Wiener band gains lets a ~10^2-parameter closed-form head match a
10^7-parameter trained decoder everywhere, including the one cell
(`sharp__cahn_hilliard`) where B1's capacity advantage survived" — is
FALSIFIED if **(L1)** the scored arm loses to the in-job Wiener-calibrated
`ref_decoder_big` by more than that dataset's certified
`min_claimable_effect` on ≥ 2 of {pfc 0.21303, allen_cahn 0.87970, fisher_kpp
0.00071, cahn_hilliard 0.09125, ifc_poisson 0.93770}, **or (L2)** on
`sharp__cahn_hilliard` the out-of-fold-selected closed-form arm still loses to
`ref_decoder_big` by > 0.27374 skill units (3× the certified cahn_hilliard
mce 0.09125, against B1's measured 0.5511-unit gap), **or (L3)** the scored
arm is worse than 1.05× the best frozen floor on any scored panel dataset
(pfc > 62.80, allen_cahn > 282.66, fisher_kpp > 12.593, cahn_hilliard >
24.339) or worse than 1.15× on `ifc_poisson` (> 11.563), **or (L4)** the
pre-registered selection rule is beaten on test by its own non-selected
alternative (`ref_selrule_alt`) by more than that dataset's mce on ≥ 2 panel
datasets; `ext__helmholtz_2d` is report-only with the zero-floor column and
carries no falsification weight (its certified mce 2.9530 exceeds any effect
available against a floor of 3.3441), and every number is labelled
`provisional-single-seed`.

6_analysis.falsification_postmortem:
H-r2s1-B2 was correctly recorded as FALSIFIED - L1 and L2 both fired on numbers that are reproducible to 1e-16 and stable across all 5 fold resamples - but the three turns reallocate the falsification almost entirely away from the mechanism the hypothesis named ('the map is capacity-limited after all'), and each firing cell fails for a different, now-identified reason.

(1) allen_cahn (L1 cell 1, +6.1511 = 6.99x mce): a POST-HOC-STAGE artifact, not a capacity result. Before the shared stages the 4-parameter head beats the 15.85M-parameter decoder by 26.6966 skill (30.35x mce); the blend stage then hands the decoder +22.3241 because the blend is an error-decorrelation ensemble and the head's errors are collinear (fitted rho = 1.0000, RMS residual 1e-6) with the dc_only base's while the decoder's are at rho ~ 0.69-0.78. Substituting the decoder's own measured rho into the same closed form reverses the cell by 2.07-7.15x mce. The hypothesis's claim on this dataset is in fact true in a STRONGER form than tested: a 10-parameter per-mode out-of-fold-selected quadratic map finishes 23.6x mce ahead of the decoder, with the blend standing down to lambda = 1.

(2) cahn_hilliard (L1 cell 2 and all of L2, +1.2963 = 14.21x mce): the only honest capacity-flavoured loss, and it decomposes as 0.5160 selection-rule ARITY DEFECT (the rule uses the cardinality of the identifiable-mode set instead of the set; repairable train-side for 5.6x mce) + <=0.011 map/shrinkage null (every identifiable mode selects affine out of fold) + a residual 0.7803 = 8.55x mce that survives four excluded mechanisms and is attributed by H2 to a spatial inductive bias reaching the energy-heavy, condition-unidentifiable modes 2-3 - untestable in this card because the run shipped no decoder predictions. Note that L2 would have fired even under the full repair (0.78359 > 0.27374), so the leg's verdict is robust to the defect; what changes is the MECHANISM the verdict licenses, not the verdict.

(3) The three non-firing L1 cells were never informative: pfc and fisher_kpp are empty cells (0 of 30 condition-identifiable modes after DC removal under affine/quadratic/kernel/kNN maps; every arm's error collinear with dc_only's), and ifc_poisson is an N=5 cell where the blend replaced 95% of the decoder and 85% of the head with a closed-form base. The pre-registered '>= 2 of 5' L1 threshold was therefore effectively '>= 2 of 3', and it fired on both of the two cells where anything was measurable.

(4) L3 and L4 did not fire and both stand up: the scored arm beat the best frozen floor on all 5 scored panel datasets (0.5718x-0.9689x of floor), and the pre-registered selection rule beat its own alternative by 2.25x mce on allen_cahn and 5.24x mce on cahn_hilliard, losing only on the N=5 ifc_poisson cell. The L4 vindication survives turns 1-3 intact - which is worth stating precisely, because the same rule carries the arity defect: the rule's CENTERING choice is vindicated; its RANK choice is right in cardinality and wrong in indexing.

Net: the identification-vs-capacity question the card set out to decide is answered 'identification' on allen_cahn (nonlinearity of the condition->coefficient map, 10 parameters), 'instrument' on the post-hoc stage, 'empty' on pfc/fisher_kpp/ifc_poisson, and 'still open, 8.55x mce, one named hypothesis' on cahn_hilliard only.
surprises: The falsification's decisive cell was decided by a stage that is not part of either arm. The blend was included as a fairness device (identical code path for all arms) and instead behaved as a systematic bias: its payoff is a monotone function of error decorrelation from the closed-form bases, a quantity on which closed-form heads and trained decoders differ by construction. The head does not merely correlate with the dc_only base - it IS that base to 1.8e-5 on allen_cahn.

A 10-parameter out-of-fold-selected quadratic beats a 15,853,057-parameter decoder by 23.6x mce on allen_cahn, at 99.2% of its mode set's ORACLE ceiling - while the card's own pre-registered nonlinear rung (ref_head_rff16, one shared random-feature map for all modes) scored WORSE than affine. The nonlinearity question was answered 'yes' by a form the card did not include and 'no' by the form it did.

The selection rule's own diagnostic was correct and its use of that diagnostic was not: stage S computes a per-mode identifiability vector and then discards everything but its cardinality. The single-number-per-dataset framing hid a set-vs-window bug that cost 5.6x mce on the one dataset whose identifiable modes are non-contiguous - and which POD's energy ordering makes systematically likely whenever the condition-predictable content is low-energy (here the DC direction, 0.45% of basis energy).

The pre-registered 'grid edge' anomaly pointed the wrong way. The band-3 gain pinned at 2.0 looked like clipped amplitude; it is a 40-sample overfit whose least-squares-optimal value is a SHRINK to 0.64, and the widening the card had already applied once (from 1.5 to 2.0, after B1) made things slightly worse rather than better.

Two of the six panel datasets carry no condition-identifiable non-DC structure whatsoever in the stripped view - not merely 'hard', but zero of 30 modes under four map families. Scoring them as condition-only evidence cells was measuring dc_only plus noise, which silently converted L1's '2 of 5' into '2 of 3'.
